questions.q_en:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some Cat is Tiger

Some Cat is Jaguar

Conclusions:

I. Some Tiger is Jaguar

II. All Tiger is Jaguar
questions.solution_en:
Statements:

Some Cat is Tiger

Some Cat is Jaguar

Some Tiger is Jaguar: There is no direct relationship between Tiger and Jaguar. So, conclusion I is false.

All Tiger is Jaguar: There is no direct relationship between Tiger and Jaguar. So, conclusion II is false.

Hence, neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.q_en:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B'

'A - B' means 'A is the father of B'

'A $ B' means 'A is the son of B'

'A % B' means 'A is the sister of B'

'A & B' means 'A is the wife of B'

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the brother of B'

Which of the following coded chains means N is the aunt of P?
questions.solution_en:
Option (a) N % G & H - I + P

N % G → N is sister of G

G & H → G is wife of H => H is brother-in-law of N

H - I → H is father of I => I is child of H

I + P → I is mother of P => I is parent of P

Here, N is the sister of P's grandmother.

Option (b) N ÷ J % K + L $ P

N ÷ J → N is brother of J

J % K → J is sister of K => K is sibling of N

K + L → K is mother of L => L is niece/nephew of N

L $ P → L is son of P => P is parent of L. L is male member.

Here, N is the brother-in-law of P.

Option (c) N - D + E % F $ P

N - D → N is father of D

D + E → D is mother of E => E is grandchild of N

E % F → E is sister of F => F is grandchild of N

F $ P → F is son of P => P is parent of F

Here, N is the father-in-law of P.

Option (d) N % C & A - B ÷ P

N % C → N is sister of C.

C & A → C is wife of A.

A - B → A is father of B.

B ÷ P → B is brother of P.

Here, N is the aunt of P.

questions.q_en: If 19 November 2003 is Wednesday, then what will be the day of the week on 25 March 2011?
questions.solution_en:
Years: 2003 to 2010 = 7 years

Leap years:2004, 2008 = 2

Days: 7 X 365 + 2 = 2557

19 Nov 2010 to 25 Mar 2011:

19 Nov to 31 Dec 2010: 11 + 31 = 42

Jan 2011: 31, Feb: 28, Mar 1-25: 25

Total: 42 + 31 + 28 + 25 = 126

Total days: 2557 + 126 = 2683

Weeks: 2683 ÷ 7 = 383 weeks + 2 days

Wednesday + 2: Friday

Option (b) is the correct answer.

= 283 - 23

= 497 - 3
